    dim_sub_district.sub_district_name,
    SUM(fact_child_immunization_specialized.vitamin_a_dose_1) as total_vitamin_a_dose_1,
    SUM(fact_child_immunization_specialized.rotavirus_1) as total_rotavirus_1
FROM fact_child_immunization_specialized
JOIN dim_sub_district ON fact_child_immunization_specialized.sub_district_id = dim_sub_district.sub_district_id
JOIN dim_month ON fact_child_immunization_specialized.month_id = dim_month.month_id
JOIN dim_year ON dim_month.year_id = dim_year.year_id

    AND dim_sub_district.sub_district_name IN (

        FROM dim_sub_district d1
        JOIN dim_sub_district d2 ON d1.sub_district_name = d2.sub_district_name
        WHERE d1.type_of_area = 'Urban'
            AND d2.type_of_area = 'Rural'
    )
GROUP BY dim_sub_district.sub_district_name
ORDER BY dim_sub_district.sub_district_name
